simple.meaning: נָשַׁק (nâshaq) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to kiss , literally or figuratively ( touch ); also (as a mode of attachment ), to equip with weapons.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 35 times across Genesis, Exodus, Ruth, 1 Samuel, 2 Samuel, and 9 more, beginning at Genesis 27:26. Its contexts include family, family line.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נָשַׁק (H5401).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: נָשַׁק (nâshaq) / H5401 is traced through Genesis 27:26, Genesis 27:27, Genesis 29:11, Genesis 29:13 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.full: H5401. nashaq I. נָשַׁק verb kiss (Late Hebrew id. , Assyrian našâku , נְשַׁק נְשֵׁיק, ᵑ7 , Syriac , kiss (originally smell [] according to Lag Nov.Psalt.Spec.24f. ): Arabic is fasten together, arrange in order , Ethiopic participle ordine dispositus, apte sertus Di 641, pos. akin to II. נשׁק ); — Qal Perfect 3masculine singular ׳נ 1Kin 19:18 ; 2Sam 15:5 ; 3 feminine singular נָָֽשְׁקָה Prov 7:13 ; 3 plural נָשָׁ֑קוּ Psa 85:11 ; Imperfect יִּשַּׁק Gen 41:40 , וַיִּשַּׁק 27:27 +; suffix יִשָּׁקֵ֫נִי Song 1:2 ; 1 singular cohortative אֶשֳּׁקָהֿ 1Kin 19:20 ; 3 masculine plural יִשָּׁק֑וּן Hosea 13:2 , etc.; Imperative וּשֲׁקָה Gen 27:26 ; Infinitive construct נְשָׁקֿ 2Sam 20:9 ; — kiss , usually with לְ person: Gen 27:26 , 29 ; 50:1 ; Exod 4:27 (all J), Gen 48:10 ; Exod 18:7 (both E), 2Sam 15:5 ; 14:33 ; 19:40 ; 20:9 ; 1Kin 19:20 ; Prov 7:13 ; Ruth 1:9 , 4 ; so of idol-worship 1Kin 19:18 (compare We Skizzen iii. 105 ; Heid. 109), compare לְפִי יָדִי וַתִּשַּׁק Job 31:27 and my hand hath kissed my mouth ; rarely with accusative of person 1Sam 20:41 ( אֶתרֵֿעֵהוּ אִישׁ ), suffix person 10:1 ; Canticles (+ מִגְּשִׁיקוֺת ), Song 8:1 ; also Gen 33:4 וַֹיִֹּשָֹּׁקֵֹהֹֹוּ (J; Holz E; word suspicious, Di rejects); יִשּׁ ׳עֲגָלִים Hosea 13:2 claves do they kiss ; יִשָּׁ֑ק שְׁפָתַיִם Prov 24:26 lips he kisses ; absolute Psa 85:11 (figurative, reciprocal) . — יִשַּׁק עַלמִּֿיךָ Gen 41:40 is dubious, Di.
